sculpture_6thybone.title: Bone
sculpture_6thybone.identity: Long ochre weathered femur with uneven swollen knuckles, slim gently curved shaft and porous ends.

sculpture_7item250.title: Signet Ring
sculpture_7item250.identity: Thick yellow gold signet band with raised square black face, silver rim and white coiled dragon seal. Preserve the ring opening.
sculpture_7item250.materials: gold band; black seal; ivory dragon engraving

sculpture_7item261.title: Knight Statuette
sculpture_7item261.identity: Silver armoured knight statuette standing on a square stepped engraved stone plinth. Closed pointed helmet; left hand on hip; right hand holds a long straight sword vertically with its tip on the plinth.
sculpture_7item261.materials: antique silver steel knight; grey engraved stone plinth

sculpture_7item262.title: Eagle Statuette
sculpture_7item262.identity: Small golden eagle with both wings spread horizontally, facing forward, talons resting on a gold sphere on a short square stepped base.

sculpture_7item263.title: Angel Statuette
sculpture_7item263.identity: Classical pale stone female angel statuette, long hair, bare torso, large feathered wings swept backwards, standing with one knee bent on a square stepped stone plinth. Preserve the exact graceful pose.

sculpture_7item270.title: Zokarr IV's Skull
sculpture_7item270.identity: Aged human skull including attached jaw and teeth, yellowed mottled ivory, round cranium and deep hollow eye sockets. No crown or invented royal decoration.

sculpture_7item271.title: Thigh Bone
sculpture_7item271.identity: Short pale ivory thigh bone with broad lobed rounded ends, slightly bowed thin shaft, transverse resting pose.

sculpture_7item272.title: Haldar's Remains
sculpture_7item272.identity: Small capped purple reliquary urn, ovoid violet blue body enclosed in an open golden cage of looping ribs, circular gold foot and domed gold stopper.
sculpture_7item272.materials: violet enamel body; gold cage and cap

sculpture_7item291.title: Dragon Egg
sculpture_7item291.identity: Small asymmetrical ovoid dragon egg with pale beige mottled shell and sparse dark diagonal fissures; resting on its side.

sculpture_7item369.title: Abbey Normal Golem Head
sculpture_7item369.identity: Abbey Normal golem head: detached stern gold Egyptian pharaoh face with blue and gold striped nemes, three hanging lappets including central chin beard, broad blue circular crown edged in gold and two LARGE tall ivory horns curling upward beside the crown. Preserve its specific face and proportions.
sculpture_7item369.materials: gold face and trim; cobalt blue enamel stripes; ivory horns

sculpture_7item370.title: Golem head
sculpture_7item370.identity: Golem head: detached stern gold Egyptian pharaoh face with blue and gold striped nemes, three hanging lappets including chin beard, broad circular blue crown rimmed in gold, rounded gold brow plate and two shorter narrow ivory horns curling up at the sides. Distinct from the large ivory-horned Abbey Normal head.
sculpture_7item370.materials: gold face and trim; cobalt blue enamel stripes; ivory horns

sculpture_crysskull.title: Crystal Skull
sculpture_crysskull.identity: Complete human skull with jaw and neat teeth carved from faceted pale icy blue crystal, empty eye sockets and angular crystalline cranium.
sculpture_crysskull.materials: pale blue crystal, opaque frosted facets with restrained translucence

sculpture_item270.title: Heart of Fire
sculpture_item270.identity: Squat asymmetric angular orange faceted crystal, broad short irregular prism with bevelled corners and pointed ends, matching the Heart of Fire icon.

sculpture_item271.title: Heart of Water
sculpture_item271.identity: Squat asymmetric angular lavender-blue faceted crystal, broad short irregular prism with bevelled corners and pointed ends, matching the Heart of Water icon.

sculpture_item272.title: Heart of Air
sculpture_item272.identity: Squat asymmetric angular pale silver-grey faceted crystal, broad short irregular prism with bevelled corners and pointed ends, matching the Heart of Air icon.

sculpture_item273.title: Heart of Earth
sculpture_item273.identity: Squat asymmetric angular green faceted crystal, broad short irregular prism with bevelled corners and pointed ends, matching the Heart of Earth icon.

sculpture_item293.title: Remains of Korbu
sculpture_item293.identity: Remains of Korbu: a compact disarticulated humanoid skeleton arranged as in the icon: ribcage to the left, attached spine and pelvis, skull to the right, loosely bent arm and leg bones around it. Not a standing skeleton. Preserve the complete arrangement.

sculpture_item298.title: Idol of the Snake
sculpture_item298.identity: Golden Idol of the Snake: thick upright S-curved open-mouthed serpent with narrow reptilian snout, small fangs, forked tongue, a gold halo/loop behind its head and large red sphere enclosed by the lower coil and vertical gold claw-like prongs. Preserve this unique silhouette.
sculpture_item298.materials: antique yellow gold serpent and rings; polished red sphere

sculpture_item305.title: Bone of Doom
sculpture_item305.identity: Long dark weathered femur Bone of Doom with two swollen knuckles and slim curved shaft; same underlying femur form as 6thybone but darker brown grey bone.

sculpture_item308.title: Wyvern Horn
sculpture_item308.identity: Single curved wyvern horn, thick broad blunt rounded root tapering to a long dark hooked tip, gold ochre keratin with fine longitudinal striations, lying on its convex side.
sculpture_item308.materials: gold ochre keratin with dark brown tip

sculpture_quill.title: Harpy Feather
sculpture_quill.identity: Thin white and ochre harpy feather with narrow gold shaft and fine brown barb markings. Existing relief is suitable for this genuinely flat item.

sculpture_skull.title: Ethric's Skull
sculpture_skull.identity: Ethric human skull with attached lower jaw, large dark eye sockets, broad forehead, grey ivory facial bones and dark mottled brown rear cranium. No hat or ornaments.
sculpture_skull.materials: weathered grey ivory bone; dark brown cranium

sculpture_statuet1.title: Tiger Statuette
sculpture_statuet1.identity: Golden tiger statuette, lean long feline body standing on four paws, head turned slightly toward viewer at left, straight low tail sweeping right. No plinth. Preserve feline face and low shoulder height.

sculpture_statuet2.title: Bear Statuette
sculpture_statuet2.identity: Golden bear statuette standing on all four short thick legs, broad heavy torso, small rounded ears and blunt bear muzzle facing left. No plinth.

sculpture_statuet3.title: Wolf Statuette
sculpture_statuet3.identity: Golden wolf statuette standing alert on all four legs, tall pointed ears, long narrow muzzle facing left, straight front legs, thick hindquarters and bushy tail sweeping to the right. No plinth. Preserve the standing pose in the icon.

sculpture_statuet4.title: Eagle Statuette
sculpture_statuet4.identity: Golden eagle statuette perched directly on two feet with folded feathered wings and a long tail, hooked beak facing left, no pedestal or sphere. Distinct from the wings-spread MM7 eagle.

sculpture_statuet5.title: Dragon Statuette
sculpture_statuet5.identity: Golden dragon statuette with no visible wings, seated thick hindquarters, two small raised foreclaws, long upright curved neck, horned reptilian head facing left, long heavy tail curled around behind to the right. No plinth.
